newsitem.title: UK: Moldovan govt approves telecoms privatisation plan.
newsitem.headline: Moldovan govt approves telecoms privatisation plan.

text.p: The Moldovan government said on Saturday it had approved a plan to privatise the national telephone company Moldtelecom and aimed to present it soon to parliament.

A statement issued at the annual meeting of the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) said the plan, which will offer a 40 percent stake to a strategic investor, was given the green light on Thursday.
"The government aims to ensure, through this plan, that the full range of modern telecommunications services is available in Moldova within three years," the statement said.
The government, which will retain 60 percent control of the company, wants the strategic partner to bring in substantial new capital as well as technical and commercial expertise.
After parliamentary approval, a tender will be organised to attract bidders from among international telecommunications operators.
The government expects the tender process to be completed and the new company launched by the last quarter of this year.
